name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source webshop and billing panel for hosting companies, with products, invoices, tickets and server provisioning, backed by MariaDB and Redis.

alerts.message: An administrator is created on the first start: sign in at /admin with ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment, then change the email and password in your account. Changing those variables later has no effect.

Paymenter runs behind the reverse proxy. Add it under Admin > Settings > Security > Trusted Proxies (for example *) or file uploads fail. Outgoing email needs SMTP settings under Admin > Settings > Mail.
